product_updates.title: AI hedge fund Situational Awareness may have sold its public portfolio, but it still has its Anthropic shares
product_updates.content: The former OpenAI researcher’s fund was forced to unwind public equities after leveraged public bets plummeted. But he still has cards to play.

product_updates.title: Reddit reports a solid quarter but shows signs of AI’s impact
product_updates.content: Reddit's financial situation is looking good but uncertainty about its relationship to Google and the new AI-ified web are stirring market concerns.

product_updates.title: Investors love AI, as long as you’re a cloud host
product_updates.content: Amazon isn't slowing down on data center spending — but investors don't seem to mind.

product_updates.title: Judge says Trump admin still lacks evidence for Anthropic ‘supply-chain risk’ label
product_updates.content: A federal judge said the Trump administration has not presented enough evidence to justify labeling Anthropic a supply-chain risk, casting doubt on the government's ban on its AI technology.

product_updates.title: Friend, the lonely AI wearable, returns with a new voice and a much bigger price tag
product_updates.content: Friend, the AI wearable, can now talk to its users — for an enhanced price.

product_updates.title: Google says it fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
product_updates.content: As experts have warned for the last two years, some companies — like Microsoft and now Google — are finding and patching an exponential number of bugs in their products, thanks to the use of LLMs and AI tools.

product_updates.title: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated ‘slop’
product_updates.content: LinkedIn is introducing new ways to reduce low-quality AI-generated posts, including a “seems like AI slop” reporting option. It's also replacing its own AI writing feature with a proofreading tool.

product_updates.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso — source says for about $200M
product_updates.content: The deal gives Okta identity threat detection capabilities as enterprises seek to secure AI agents and other non-human identities across cloud environments.

product_updates.title: Meta says AI is making it easier to build new apps — and more are coming
product_updates.content: Meta says AI is making it dramatically easier to build and launch new consumer apps, with CEO Mark Zuckerberg telling investors the company has more new consumer products on the way.

product_updates.title: Nscale buys Anyscale as it seeks to own more of the AI compute stack
product_updates.content: British AI neocloud Nscale is buying software startup Anyscale, which helps companies scale their AI workloads across data centers and servers.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Montana’s plan to become an experimental medical hub just pushed forward
technical_breakthroughs.content: As of this week in Montana, any biotech company with an experimental drug has a clear path to selling it to consumers. technical_breakthroughs.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
technical_breakthroughs.content: Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.
